# webtables/mod

> Remainder: `%`, with the sign of the left operand, with `i64.rem_s`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/mod.pkg) · translates [std/mod](../std/mod.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.
Dividing by zero, or the most negative number by -1, traps.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.rem_s
{left}
{right}
)
```
